name: sdss_colors
preprocessing: Published features, no scaling; evaluator standardizes per dataset.
sql_where: s.zWarning = 0 AND p.clean = 1 AND p.psfMag_r BETWEEN 15 AND 19.5
citation: SDSS DR18, Almeida et al. (2023), ApJS 267:44
construction: Spectroscopic classes STAR and GALAXY (first 6000 each by specobjid, i.e. earliest SDSS-I/II plates; clean photometry, 15<r_psf<19.5) are clusters; QSOs downsampled to 5% (seed=0) are anomalies. Colours + concentration only; redshift deliberately excluded (it would make QSOs trivial).
